name: vectors
summary: Module 06 takes no IRIS LOCK anywhere (grep over EmbedQueue, EmbedQueueTask, IVFIndex, VecIndex, PLAIDSearch, GraphStores and the Python vector code; footprints/06.json; live tr-locklog-06: 691 store_embedding+ivf_insert pairs held no IVG lock). The only lock is an in-process threading.Lock per route on the route-creation path (embeddings.py:78-104, 292-303). Vector writes are one write_txn each (DELETE then INSERT) under IRIS row locks and the UNIQUE (graph_id, node_id) key. Two lock-plan obligations are violated live with existing registered evidence (worker vs worker on one queue entry: F-C0670; index build vs search: HD-0602's working contract); the rest are violated in source or model only, unclear, or not needed. No new live run was made for module 06 in this lane.

inventory.what: threading.Lock per (registry, graph, model_key, kind), in-process only, route-creation path of resolve_route
write_txn: DELETE then INSERT of the vector row(s); IRIS row locks to commit; UNIQUE (graph_id, node_id)

write_txn: registry INSERT arbitrated by the primary key, claim UPDATE ... WHERE model_key IS NULL + re-read
write_txn: INSERT ... SELECT from quarantine then DELETE, no rowcount check

obligations.entry_points: two writers of one vector row: store_embedding(s), embed_nodes, process_embed_queue, POST /admin/embed vs each other or vs ProcessBatch's INSERT OR UPDATE

obligations.notes: Unclear: E-UNIQUE predicts a refusal (-119) of the later writer rather than serialisation; the DELETE gap against INSERT OR UPDATE is outside the IRIS contract. Probe P3 of the draft not run.

cell.product_basis: lock plan stated per entry-point group (15 obligations): module 06 takes no IRIS LOCK (tr-locklog-06); worker vs worker on one queue entry violated live (F-C0670, intent-a-hd0604-queue-claim) and in the vec_queue model (as-built violation, reviewed pass, control caught); build vs search violated live against HD-0602 (intent-a-hd0602-ivf-partial) and in vec_build_publish; index counter race model-checked (vec_ivf, F-0608); re-enqueue race model only (F-C0601)
cell.reason: No IRIS LOCK in module 06; the obligations that need one are violated (live: F-C0670, HD-0602 run; model: F-C0601, F-0608).
cell.remaining: LP-06-3 (enqueue vs enqueue, half-written entry), LP-06-4 (two writers of one vector row: refusal vs serialisation, INSERT OR UPDATE in the DELETE gap), LP-06-5 (two-process route creation) and LP-06-15 (double placement) not exercised live; LP-06-6 rests on a product test, not a lock-plan proof; LP-06-1 live run used two claimants, not ProcessBatch vs process_embed_queue.
